checkpoints.description: [1/5] Plan Tessera: pure seamless-pattern engine, static browser studio, SVG export, tests, and an embed contract for the AegeanWorks site

impact_assessment.why: The user wants a new static showcase project for the website, like Prism-Relay but not necessarily a game; a zero-dependency pattern studio is instantly visible, interactive and useful without a backend.
impact_assessment.benefits: A polished, offline-capable browser demo with deterministic pattern generation, crisp SVG export, accessible controls, and a commit-versioned build the website can embed.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new standalone project plus a website-ready static layout; dependency: none beyond Node 20 for tests and tooling; concurrency: the AegeanWorks playable-weft work is uncommitted and must not be overwritten; state: localStorage preferences and URL parameters.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Build and test the pure engine first, keep runtime files under index.html and src/**, avoid touching the website repo while its playable task is uncommitted, and run the project gates before delivery.

checkpoints.description: [1/3] Pure export-size table and PNG filename module; DOM-free raster orchestrator with injected canvas/image adapters; failing-first tests

impact_assessment.why: Tessera can export only 1600x1067 SVG; a pattern studio needs wallpaper and phone PNGs without a screenshot tool, and users cannot use the exported art as a wallpaper today.
impact_assessment.benefits: One click produces a crisp PNG at a stated size from the same seamless tile; sizes and filenames are data, so the raster path is testable in Node and stays independent of DOM code.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new studio/export.js and studio/raster.js modules plus a new sidebar control; dependency: none (Canvas/Blob browser APIs, no new packages); concurrency: none, read-only state; state: no change to the versioned localStorage record or URL schema.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Keep raster.js free of DOM globals by injecting createCanvas/loadImage from app.js; validate dimensions against a 16.7 MP ceiling; failing-first tests for sizes, naming, draw calls and failure paths; static contract stays green.

checkpoints.description: [3/3] PNG export shipped: frozen wallpaper/Full HD/4K/phone/square size table, DOM-free raster orchestrator with injected canvas/image adapters, sidebar export block with P shortcut, README and ADR-006, v0.2.0. 85 Node tests in budget, 4/4 project gates, static contract; Edge headless produced 1080x1080 and 3840x2160 PNGs plus the createImageBitmap fallback with zero console errors; no overflow at 320/390/768/1024/1440/1920 and the 768px two-column grid pairs cleanly. checklists: passed
